content: .{@-स्थानकम्@} (in dramaturgy) intimation of an episodical incident, when instead of the thing thought of or expected, another of the same character is brought in by some unexpected circumstance (यत्रार्थे चिन्तितेऽन्यस्मिंस्तल्लिङ्गोऽन्यः प्रयुज्यते . आगन्तुकेन भावेन पताकास्थानकं तु तत् .. <ls>S. D. 299</ls>; for its different kinds, see 300-304).
